title: Downhill Race

exclude: zero page: the Downhill Race's position, scroll, sprite and sound state, written at run time
not the Downhill Race's: neither its files nor its code write or read these bytes (simulator write and read maps from the hand-over and from play); left by earlier programs
run-time buffers: the two characters under each of the 35 flags, saved when a flag is knocked down ($161F, $162E) and put back by restore_flags ($1651)
mirror tables computed at start-up by build_mirror_tables ($1E48): $0700 reverses the 8 bits of a byte, $0600 reverses its four bit pairs; no byte of them is loaded
left by earlier loads after the load stub; the Downhill Race does not write or read them

inside file $1B between the note frequency table and load_file_numbers: an alternating $FF/$00 fill with a few stray bits, like uninitialised RAM saved with the file; no instruction reaches it (the table reads are indexed by a nibble or a slot offset) and the simulator never read it
the end of file $1B past the last variable ($3F82): an alternating $00/$FF fill with a few stray bits, like uninitialised RAM, that no code reads (simulator read map, opcode scan)
the tail of font file $23 (characters $FD-$FF) past the end of file $27; the status rows only use characters below $40 and nothing else reads it
four 64-byte sprite buffers (blocks $D0-$D3) that build_pose_sprites ($2760, $2A52) fills at run time from the pose shapes; no byte is loaded
three bytes between the end of file $26 ($7DFC) and file $1F ($7E00); not loaded, not read
forty bytes between the end of file $1F ($A5D7) and file $1E ($A600): not loaded and not read, identical to High Jump's memory
forty bytes between the end of file $1E ($CDD7) and the copy of file $1C ($CE00): not loaded and not read, identical to High Jump's memory
past the copy of file $1D: eight bytes the copy loop at $1E1B takes from beyond the file, then the tail of a RAM copy of the KERNAL from an earlier load; nothing reads them
stale bytes between the loader and the event manager, unchanged since the title; nothing refers to them
extra: font file $23, characters $00-$3F, shown in the status rows ($D018 = $40)
file $24: the eleven overlay sprites, blocks $08-$12
files $25 (the messages) and $27 (the sound-effect tables and scripts)
files $21 and $22: the riding sprites, blocks $50-$CF
file $26: the music (phrase table, scripts, phrase chooser code, note streams, phrase graph)
file $1F: the colour and terrain map, 255 rows of 40
file $1E: the character map, 255 rows of 40
files $1C and $1D copied under the I/O area: the pose directories and the pose shapes
include: files $1C and $1D are copied under the I/O area: the pose directory and shapes, read with $01 = $24
